widget.instructions: Change a lane's speed with its controls, then press Play.

steps.text: Speed tells you how many metres are covered each second. Press Play: the cyclist covers more metres every second.
Distance = speed × time: after 4 s the cyclist at 5 m/s has gone 20 m.
Rearranged: speed = distance ÷ time, and time = distance ÷ speed. Check the units: m ÷ (m/s) = s.

args.text: d = v t, v = d ÷ t, t = d ÷ v

steps.text: Cover the quantity you want: d on top, v and t below.
Covering t leaves d over v: time = distance ÷ speed. Press Play and read when the walker reaches 6 m.

recap.text: Recap: d = v × t; v = d ÷ t; t = d ÷ v. Keep the units consistent.

accessibility.altText: Two lanes: a walker and a cyclist moving at steady speeds.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Type speeds in the lane controls and press Play; the description gives every position.
